result.summary: The page displays two primary visual issues concerning missing content assets and layout constraints.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a broken image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Verify image URL integrity and ensure assets are properly uploaded to the CDN.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated prematurely in the horizontal scroll section.
issues.suggestion: Enable text wrapping or reduce horizontal padding to fit longer restaurant names.
